title: Truth of a quantified Boolean formula
statement: Given a Boolean list $qs$, a conjunctive normal form formula $\varphi$ over natural-number variables, and natural numbers $k,S$, the predicate holds exactly when $\varphi$ is true under the quantifier prefix obtained by dropping the first $k$ bits of $qs$ and interpreting the remaining bits as quantifiers, with variables assigned by the binary assignment determined by $k$ and $S$ and with parameter $k$.
caveat: The supplied snippet does not define the semantics of the external quantified-formula truth predicate or the bit-to-quantifier convention.
